text: On holiday in Tuscany, the Danish couple Bjørn and Louise and their daughter Agnes befriend a warm Dutch family, and soon [accept an invitation to their remote country house|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. Over a long weekend the hosts mock Louise's vegetarianism, leave the children with a stranger, and treat their son Abel, born without a tongue, with open scorn. Each slight is small enough to excuse, and the guests [keep smiling and stay|wrong|failing to protect], until Bjørn finds a cabin [walled with photographs of other families|images|pictures, screens and recordings].
